basic_details.job_title: ICAR-IISS Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 2 Senior Research Fellow, Young Professional Posts
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in test and interview for the Senior Research Fellow post will be held on 9 December 2026 and for the Young Professional-II post on 11 December 2026, both at 10:00 A.M., at Indian Institute of Soil Science, Nabibagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal. ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil Science (भा.कृ.अनु.प.-भारतीय मृदा विज्ञान संस्थान), Bhopal has announced one Senior Research Fellow post at Rs. 37000/- per month + HRA and one Young Professional-II post at Rs. 42,000/- per month (Fixed), under notice F. No. 12-327/2026-Estt. dated 17 November 2026.

age_limit.details: Relaxation of age is given in case of Women/SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per ICAR / Government norms. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or the number of years of relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

important_instructions: The positions are purely on temporary basis, and the appointment will be co-terminus with the termination of the project. The engagement will be initially for a period of six months/one year or till termination of the project; extension will be given subject to satisfactory performance of the work. Other terms and conditions will be as per the guidelines for Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional-II working in the ICAR Schemes. Selected candidates will have no right whatsoever for absorption/regularization in the Institute, and selection does not entail any right for absorption/regularization at IISS and/or any other sister concern including ICAR Headquarter. Services of selected candidates can be dispensed with even before the termination of the project without any notice if the services are no more required or the contribution is considered not up to the mark. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. The decision of the Director, IISS, Bhopal would be final and binding in all aspects. Office contact printed on the letterhead: Tel. No. (0755) 2730970/2734221 (Ext. No. 233 & 256), Fax No. (0755) 2733310.

content_sections.heading: About ICAR-IISS
content_sections.text: ICAR-Indian Institute of Soil Science is an institute of the Indian Council of Agricultural Research located at Nabibagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal - 462 038 (M.P.). The interview venue is 6 K.M from Bhopal main station. The posts are contractual positions under the project "Transformation of Coal Gasification by Products into Sustainable Fertilizers" (कोयला गैसीकरण के उप-उत्पादों का सतत उर्वरकों में रूपांतरण).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Essential qualification, as printed: M. Sc. in Soil Science/Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry/Soil Chemistry and Fertility/Agricultural Chemistry with 4/5 years of Bachelor's degree. Candidates having post graduate degree in Basic Sciences with 3 years Bachelor's degree and 2 years Master degree must have *N.E.T./GATE qualification. Desirable: Experience on soil and plant sample analysis and handling of Atomic Absorption Spectrophotometer/ICP-OES. Age limit: 21 to 35 years. Pay: Rs. 37000/- per month + HRA. The test and interview for this post are on 9 December 2026 at 10:00 A.M. Essential qualification: M.Sc. in Soil Science/Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry/Agronomy. Desirable: Experience on soil and plant sample analysis. Age limit: 21 to 45 years. Pay: Rs. 42,000/- per month (Fixed). The test and interview for this post are on 11 December 2026 at 10:00 A.M. Relaxation of age is given in case of Women/SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per ICAR / Government norms. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age or the number of years of relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: The notice makes it compulsory to bring the following, and the set of copies is submitted in the office at the time of interview: Original documents for verification One set of the complete bio-data in the prescribed format, with a self-attested photograph Self-attested mark sheets Self-attested proof of date of birth Self-attested certificates for qualification and experience Self-attested caste certificate The prescribed format is the "Proforma for the Application for the Position of SRF" printed at the end of the notice. It has a box for a photograph and asks for: full name (in capital letters); present and permanent address, mobile number and e-mail; date of birth and age; educational qualification (High School (Xth), Higher Secondary (XIIth), B.Sc. with discipline, M.Sc. with discipline - with board/university, year of passing, marks obtained/total marks and percentage of marks and OGPA); experience, if any (post held, period from and to, name of department/office); publications (research, technical, popular); computer proficiency; and relevant information, followed by a declaration, place, date, signature and name.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: All eligible candidates are requested to be present 30 minutes before the scheduled time (10:00 A.M.) for necessary formalities. Original documents are verified and the bio-data set with enclosures is submitted in the office. The notice is titled "Walk in Interview" with a test and interview (लिखित परीक्षा एवं साक्षात्कार). The Director, IISS, Bhopal reserves the right to fix criteria and short list the candidates for screening of applications/for conducting written test. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The positions are purely on temporary basis, and the appointment will be co-terminus with the termination of the project. The engagement will be initially for a period of six months/one year or till termination of the project; extension will be given subject to satisfactory performance of the work. Other terms and conditions will be as per the guidelines for Senior Research Fellow and Young Professional-II working in the ICAR Schemes. Selected candidates will have no right whatsoever for absorption/regularization in the Institute, and selection does not entail any right for absorption/regularization at IISS and/or any other sister concern including ICAR Headquarter. Services of selected candidates can be dispensed with even before the termination of the project without any notice if the services are no more required or the contribution is considered not up to the mark. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. The decision of the Director, IISS, Bhopal would be final and binding in all aspects. Office contact printed on the letterhead: Tel. No. (0755) 2730970/2734221 (Ext. No. 233 & 256), Fax No. (0755) 2733310.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ICAR-IISS walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The test and interview for Senior Research Fellow is on 9 December 2026 and for Young Professional-II on 11 December 2026, both at 10:00 A.M.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the venue and when should I report?
faq.answer: The venue is Indian Institute of Soil Science, Nabibagh, Berasia Road, Bhopal, 6 K.M from Bhopal main station. Candidates are requested to be present 30 minutes before the scheduled time.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Senior Research Fellow and 1 Young Professional-II.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: M. Sc. in Soil Science/Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry/Soil Chemistry and Fertility/Agricultural Chemistry with 4/5 years of Bachelor's degree; candidates with a post graduate degree in Basic Sciences (3 years Bachelor's and 2 years Master degree) must have *N.E.T./GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for the Young Professional-II post?
faq.answer: M.Sc. in Soil Science/Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry/Agronomy, with experience on soil and plant sample analysis as desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 35 years for Senior Research Fellow and 21 to 45 years for Young Professional-II, with relaxation for Women/SC/ST/OBC/PH candidates as per ICAR / Government norms.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary, and is HRA paid on top of it?
faq.answer: Senior Research Fellow gets Rs. 37000/- per month + HRA. Young Professional-II gets Rs. 42,000/- per month, printed as fixed.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Original documents for verification, one set of complete bio-data in the prescribed format with a self-attested photograph, and self-attested mark sheets, proof of date of birth, qualification and experience certificates and caste certificate.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Through a test and interview; the Director, IISS, Bhopal reserves the right to fix criteria and short list candidates for screening of applications or for conducting the written test.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The positions are purely on temporary basis, initially for six months/one year or till termination of the project, with no right to absorption or regularization.
